== English Death Star II comparison ==
The original sets total battle destiny at zero. The August 2012 rulebook uses the instruction “reset” and writes the value as 0. The current full face, printable slip and later Appendix agree. The linked card-data entry includes “may reset.” A matching dated rules publication or face for that wording has yet to surface. The source record links the exact current published face and slip.
